title: Screen Interaction Architecture Matrix

decisionRules.P01: Overview: summarize a module/domain; navigate to owned jobs.
decisionRules.P02: List: browse/search/filter many records; create in page header; row actions operate or navigate.
decisionRules.P03: Resource Detail: inspect one resource; resource-level actions in resource header.
decisionRules.P04: Create/Edit: dedicated form when more than five fields, multiple sections, deep-linking, or unsaved navigation matters.
decisionRules.P05: Settings: configure one domain/settings section at a time.
decisionRules.P06: Builder: construct a query/report/workflow; builder owns Run/Save.
decisionRules.P07: Monitor/Operations: monitor live/running state, health, or operational queues.
decisionRules.P09: Master-Detail: list/tree selection and detail/editor are one continuous job; do not use merely to avoid creating routes.
decisionRules.P10: History/Log: immutable/past events; detail may use drawer.

rowActions.rule: Single common action uses one canonical compact action. Multiple actions collapse into a More menu; destructive action is last and visually separated.
rowActions.currentProblem: Production mixes Select/Open/Test buttons and links with page-specific semantics.

editorFooter.rule: Default footer is in normal flow and visually attached to the owning editor. It may dock only after dirty state on long editors. It must not look like an unrelated floating card.

passiveExplanations.rule: INNOState is reserved for actual state. Policy/explanatory copy uses PurposeNote/InfoCallout or is removed when redundant.

spacing.rule: Card, section, field, input, button and table spacing must come from shared tokens/components; page CSS may not redefine baseline dimensions without an explicit exception.

illustrations.rule: Hero illustrations are selective module/workspace orientation aids, not decoration on every page.

specialComponents.tree: INNOTree; production implementation must exist before hierarchy remediation.
specialComponents.treeGrid: INNOTreeGrid; default direction is TanStack Table expandable rows, not Syncfusion/AG Grid by default.
specialComponents.workflowCanvas: INNOWorkflowCanvas = React Flow + ELK.js only for real editable branching Dynamic Workflow.
specialComponents.currentGap: Frozen design contract names these components but @inno/ui does not implement Tree/TreeGrid/OrgChart/WorkflowCanvas yet.

assetInformationArchitecture.assetOwner: Assets > Ownership > Asset Owners / Ownership Profiles
assetInformationArchitecture.rule: Assets may own asset-ownership metadata and Agent-submitted ownership fields, but must not appear to duplicate platform identity user administration.

remediationSequence: 44B Shared interaction foundations: Row Actions, Dialog/Drawer, integrated editor action bar, PurposeNote/InfoCallout, spacing tokens.
44C Hierarchy parity: implement INNOTree/INNOTreeGrid production wrappers; remediate Organization, Locations, Access Scope architecture.
44D Form/detail route remediation: Positions, Users edit/create, Access Scopes, Contracts, Custom Fields, affected master-detail pages.
44E Visual parity: restore approved hero illustrations and normalize card/input/button/table spacing.
44F Assets information architecture rename/ownership boundary cleanup.
44G Dynamic Workflow foundation: only if branching workflow scope is explicitly approved; add React Flow + ELK behind INNOWorkflowCanvas.
44H Full route visual QA and regression freeze.
